capabilities: synchronize Google Calendar events into notes as tasks
push Obsidian tasks with a start date to Google Calendar
render event lists in notes via a query code block
configure query time range, title template, and auto-refresh interval
extras: Early alpha and subject to change; community-plugin installation was not available at time of writing. README warns to exclude the token credentials file (calendar.sync.token.json) from vault syncing for security reasons. Sync is one-way after the initial push: later edits happen in the calendar and sync back to Obsidian, not the other way. Sort, filter, and group query features are announced for a future version.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see or manage Google Calendar events alongside its own task lists.

relations.evidence: this plugin relies on the Dataview plugin to list tasks within a specific date range
Our task format is borrowed from tasks
This plugin has borrowed a lot of valuable experience from the above plugins

requires.name: Google Calendar (via Google Cloud API credentials file)
Google Cloud project with Calendar API enabled

summary: Google Calendar integration that pulls calendar events into notes as tasks and pushes tasks with start dates back to the calendar.
